description: This file defines the Zend_Http_CookieJar class, which manages HTTP cookies within the Zend Framework. It provides methods to add, retrieve, and handle cookies across HTTP requests, including parsing HTTP responses to extract cookies. The class facilitates cookie storage, matching, and serialization, serving as a core component for HTTP client implementations in the framework.

classes.name: Zend_Http_CookieJar
classes.description: A class for storing and managing HTTP cookies, supporting operations like adding cookies, parsing cookies from HTTP responses, retrieving cookies based on request URI, and exporting cookies in various formats.

methods.name: addCookie
methods.description: Adds a cookie to the jar, accepting either a Zend_Http_Cookie object or a string representation of a cookie, and associates it with a reference URI for domain, path, and security context.

methods.name: addCookiesFromResponse
methods.description: Parses an HTTP response to extract and store cookies sent via 'Set-Cookie' headers.

methods.name: getAllCookies
methods.description: Returns all stored cookies, either as objects or as string representations, based on specified return format.

methods.name: getMatchingCookies
methods.description: Retrieves cookies matching a specified URI, optionally including session cookies, and returns them in the desired format.

methods.name: getCookie
methods.description: Fetches a specific cookie by name that matches a URI and returns it in the specified format.

methods.name: _flattenCookiesArray
methods.description: Helper method to recursively flatten cookies into an array or string format for serialization.

methods.name: _matchDomain
methods.description: Filters cookies according to domain matching rules.

methods.name: _matchPath
methods.description: Filters cookies according to path matching rules.

methods.name: fromResponse
methods.description: Creates a new CookieJar instance and populates it from an HTTP response object.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the total number of cookies stored in the jar.

methods.name: getIterator
methods.description: Provides an iterator over stored cookies, supporting foreach loops.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks whether the cookie jar contains any cookies.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Clears all cookies from the jar, resetting its state.
